title: Why people wanted the act to leave Nazarro
summary: Others saw Nazarro taking advantage; Bubbles claims the act played everything in entertainment.

blocks.x: Why were people trying to break the act up?

Because they wasn't no good. They saw the guy was taking advantage, that's what they saw. We never got what we deserved. No, uh-uh. We never put -- somebody be put that was worthwhile. We could have went in (whats'name. Look I got my voice cultivated. We could have went in Ripley's Believe It Or Not column. Look how many things we went in. We went in everything you could think of in the entertainment world. Ain't nothing you could think of we didn't go in. Believe me when I tell you. Everything. Go ahead, you think of something.
